creator_brief.ask: Share a real wearing photo on your hand in daylight. Keep it natural with no heavy filter. Tag our shop.
creator_brief.dm: Hi! We love your soft everyday style. We would love to send you our delicate gold ring to wear in your real life. If you love it, share a wearing photo and tag us. Let us know?
creator_brief.send: Delicate thin gold band ring or tiny gold hoop earrings from everyday line.
creator_brief.who: Small creators young women trust. Soft clean look. They post daily outfits, coffee, hands and tiny gold jewelry.

weeks.do: Look for small creators and send kind DMs. Get mailers ready with thank you cards.

weeks.do: Mail the rings and earrings. Share packing moments on Stories to build trust.

weeks.do: Watch for creator tags. Repost their wearing photos on Stories with thanks.
